Hi Donald,

Great news, thanks for letting us know, and thanks for the tip.

You are right that the voltage selector catches people out. On power supplies that have the little red 115/230 (or 120/240) slide switch, it has to match your wall voltage before the unit is plugged in. On a 120V circuit in North America it belongs on 115/120, and on 230/240V it belongs on the higher setting. If it is on the wrong one the miner either will not power up at all or browns out under load as soon as the hashboard draws current. I will pass your note along so we call it out more clearly in our setup guidance, since it is an easy fix that looks like a dead unit.

One thing worth repeating for anyone else reading: only ever move that switch with the supply unplugged, and never open the PSU housing.

Glad you are hashing. If anything else comes up with it, just reply here, and our Discord is a quick place to get hands-on help too: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf (JD is @nullhashrate there).

Happy mining,
Hal
